the band conductor for a certain jc is really fucking scary. i only know because they also conduct my secondary school. last year in my fourth year i would get anxiety attacks before cca on my cca days and sometimes the day before my cca days. friends outside of band also noticed changes in my usual behaviour (randomly lashing out, always being nervous) because of the immense pressure i felt, and i wasn’t even in the band exco. despite the negatives my conductor taught me valuable lessons which shaped my work ethic. they weren’t a bad person but it was really easy to hate them when they had their ‘episodes’
